blocks.text: ANTALYA, Turkey — The COP31 climate talks failed Sunday as a contentious deal collapsed over fossil fuels and the summit in Turkey stretched into record overtime. The final agreement was rejected in a chaotic finale to a UN climate summit that ran two days over schedule, underscoring the strains on diplomacy in an increasingly fractured world.
